title: Serpent Neon
logline: A modern neon-soaked reimagining of classic snake — grow your serpent, grab power-ups, and chase high scores in a pulsating arena.
visualStyle: Dark black arena (#0a0a0a) with subtle grid. Snake body is chain of glowing cyan circles (head brightest, tail fades). Food glows distinct colors (gold, green, purple). Arena walls pulse with neon border. Fading afterglow trail.
coreMechanic: Classic snake on an 18px grid. Continuous movement via delta-time tick. Eating food grows snake by 1 and spawns new food. Die on hitting self or walls. Power-ups spawn at length thresholds.

scoring.lengthBonus: 5 per current snake length when eating
scoring.nearWallBonus: 15 if head within 2 cells of any wall

gameOverCondition: Head collides with own body (unless phase-through active) or arena wall
restartBehavior: Length 3 at center, random direction, score 0

screens.intro: SERPENT NEON pulsing cyan title, animated snake coil, controls, high score, SPACE to Start
screens.hud: Score top-left with neon glow, Length top-right, Active power-up with timer top-center
screens.pause: Dark overlay with PAUSED neon text, score and length, ESC or click to resume
screens.gameOver: Snake scatter explosion, flickering GAME OVER, score, max length, food eaten, high score, click to replay
